query:
INSERT INTO news (slug, title, excerpt, coverImageUrl, blocks, categoryId, date, publishedAt, createdAt)
VALUES (
  'souvenir-pioneer-theatre-company',
  'Assistant Scenic Designer: Souvenir at Pioneer Theatre Company',
  'Supporting Jo Winiarski''s scenic design for Stephen Temperley''s comedy about the infamous soprano Florence Foster Jenkins at Pioneer Theatre Company.',
  'https://files.manuscdn.com/user_upload_by_module/session_file/310519663337866878/NXPXMDSLKDnNMpTR.jpeg',
  '[{"type":"text","content":"Souvenir brought me to Pioneer Theatre Company to support Jo Winiarski''s scenic design for Stephen Temperley''s charming comedy about Florence Foster Jenkins, the wealthy socialite whose terrible singing became legendary in 1940s New York."},{"type":"header","content":"The Production"},{"type":"text","content":"Directed by Wes Grantom, Souvenir tells the story of Florence Foster Jenkins and her accompanist Cosmé McMoon through an intimate two-character format. The play explores the unlikely friendship between the delusional diva and the pianist who must navigate her eccentricities while maintaining his professional dignity.\\n\\nJo Winiarski''s scenic design transformed Pioneer Theatre Company''s intimate Meldrum Theatre into multiple performance spaces—from Jenkins'' opulent apartment to Carnegie Hall—with elegant period details that evoked the glamour of 1940s New York. The design supported the play''s theatrical magic, allowing seamless transitions between locations while maintaining the warmth and intimacy essential to this two-hander.\\n\\nThe production ran from December 6-21, 2024, starring Broadway veterans Linda Mugleston as Florence Foster Jenkins and Bob Walton as Cosmé McMoon. Critics praised the production as a glittering jewel for the holiday season and an exceptional two-hander."},{"type":"image","url":"https://files.manuscdn.com/user_upload_by_module/session_file/310519663337866878/NXPXMDSLKDnNMpTR.jpeg","caption":"Souvenir at Pioneer Theatre Company, 2024. Scenic design by Jo Winiarski. The elegant period design evoked 1940s New York glamour in the intimate Meldrum Theatre. Photo courtesy Pioneer Theatre Company."},{"type":"header","content":"The Creative Team"},{"type":"team","title":"The Creative Team","members":[{"name":"Stephen Temperley","role":"Playwright"},{"name":"Wes Grantom","role":"Director"},{"name":"Jo Winiarski","role":"Scenic Designer"},{"name":"Brandon P.T. Davis","role":"Assistant Scenic Designer"},{"name":"Yang Yu","role":"Lighting Designer"},{"name":"K.L. Alberts","role":"Costume Designer"},{"name":"Tami Lee Thompson","role":"Hair and Makeup Design"}]},{"type":"header","content":"About Pioneer Theatre Company"},{"type":"text","content":"Pioneer Theatre Company is Utah''s premier professional theatre, presenting a season of classic and contemporary plays and musicals in two venues on the University of Utah campus. Founded in 1962, PTC has been a cornerstone of Salt Lake City''s cultural landscape for over 60 years, producing world premieres, regional premieres, and beloved classics."},{"type":"link","url":"https://pioneertheatre.org","label":"Visit Pioneer Theatre Company"}]',
  90002,
  '2024-12-21',
  '2024-12-21',
  NOW()
)
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE
  title = VALUES(title),
  excerpt = VALUES(excerpt),
  coverImageUrl = VALUES(coverImageUrl),
  blocks = VALUES(blocks),
  categoryId = VALUES(categoryId),
  date = VALUES(date),
  publishedAt = VALUES(publishedAt);
